title: CI/CD: policy lint + safe plan/apply harness for VPC IaC
creator: Arielle Chen
description:
Motivation: Harden CI/CD for VPC Terraform modules used by Private deployments. Current pain points: inconsistent linting across repos, manual policy checks, risky `apply` stages with occasional state lock contention and no automated rollback or scoring before merge. This ticket designs and implements a reusable 'safe apply' harness plus a centralized policy-as-code registry integrated into our plan/apply pipelines.

Scope:
- Standardize linting (tflint + custom rules) and run in pre-merge jobs.
- Add a policy-as-code registry (OPA policies + Conftest tests) that is versioned and referenced by pipeline by environment.
- Implement a Plan Scoring step that runs terraform plan + policy checks and produces a scorecard. If the score exceeds a threshold, block merge and create a remediation checklist.
- Replace current ad-hoc apply jobs with a Safe Apply harness: ephemeral workspace creation, automated state lock verification, canary apply for non-critical resources, automatic rollback on drift detection or quota failures.
- Emit structured metadata (plan diff summary, policy violations, scoring) to Console and to a central audit log for compliance.

Technical approach:
1) Linting: add a shared pipeline template `ci/iac-lint.yaml` that runs tflint (with our rules) and `terraform validate` using the repo's pinned provider versions. Fail fast on high-severity findings.
2) Policy registry: host policies in `git::ssh://git.company/policies/opa-registry.git` with semver tags. Pipelines fetch the policy bundle matching the target environment (e.g., `opa-registry@v1.2.0`). Conftest acts as a wrapper to run unit-style assertions locally and in CI.
3) Plan Scoring: run `terraform plan -out=plan.tfplan` then use a lightweight analyzer to produce a score (weights for: destroy counts, public access changes, new IAM roles, network egress rules). The analyzer runs OPA checks and returns a JSON scorecard.
4) Safe Apply harness: builds on ephemeral TF Cloud/remote backends; creates a canary apply for a limited subset (tags: safe_canary=true) then waits 10-15m health checks (via health-check lambda). If canary passes, continue staged apply; on failure, auto-rollback using state snapshot and create incident ticket.
5) Observability: publish plan score, policy verdicts, apply execution trace, and rollback events to Console under `IaC > Pipelines` and to Slack #infra-ops.

Acceptance criteria:
- Lint and policy jobs are added as reusable pipeline templates and used by at least 5 active VPC IaC repos.
- Plan Scoring runs reliably and blocks merges when score > configured threshold.
- Safe Apply harness executes canary applies and is able to rollback a failed canary in < 5 minutes.
- Policy registry is versioned and referenced by environment; Conftest unit tests run in CI and pass.
- Audit logs capture plan diffs and policy outputs for every merge queued to main.

Rollout plan:
- Week 1: implement pipeline templates and policy registry; add to 1 pilot repo (internal test VPC).
- Week 2: iterate on scoring weights and conftest tests; add 3 more repos.
- Week 3: enable Safe Apply harness in pilot; monitor and tune health checks.
- Week 4: formal rollout and team training, update runbooks.

Risks & mitigations:
- False positives in policy or score blocking deploys: provide override workflow with human approval and require security review for overrides.
- State lock contention during ephemeral workspaces: ensure robust retry/backoff and pre-check for active locks.
- Canary failures causing delayed deploys: limit canary to non-critical resources initially and increase scope gradually.

Related artifacts: design doc https://confluence.company/display/INF/IAc+Safe+Apply+Design ; prototype PRs: https://github.com/company/infra-pipelines/pull/1283 , https://github.com/company/opa-registry/pull/17

Notes: This is intentionally cross-cutting (infra, platform, security). We'll collaborate with Platform Eng for workspace orchestration and with Security for policy definitions.
